# Arperture Media

> Arperture Media is a cinematic AI creative studio based in Leesburg, Virginia (serving clients worldwide). We produce film-grade AI video, sound design, and branded stories for brands, artists & storytellers, and we help small businesses with AI consulting and Web Visibility (SEO, GEO & AEO). Founded by Andrew Dallons. Contact: contact@arperture.io · (571) 200-1186.

## Services

- [AI Video Services & Production](https://arperture.io/services/): Concept-to-completion AI video production — film direction, creative direction, and a 14-step cinematic pipeline.
- [AI Consulting & Search Visibility](https://arperture.io/small-business/): AI Business Analysis (from $497), AI Implementation Consulting (monthly retainer), and the Web Visibility Audit ($750 flat) scoring SEO, GEO & AEO.
- [Image & Video Enhancement, Restoration & Colorization](https://arperture.io/enhancement/): Studio-grade upscaling, damage repair, and black-and-white colorization for photos and video, priced by tier and quoted up front.
- [Training & Consulting](https://arperture.io/training/): 1:1 sessions, team workshops, and custom curriculum for teams adopting AI video.

## Work

- [Portfolio](https://arperture.io/portfolio/): AI-directed films, music videos, and branded content.
- [Yield Bookkeeping Services (case study)](https://arperture.io/portfolio/yield/): A full AI-powered brand video campaign.
- [Judge Silverback's Court (case study)](https://arperture.io/portfolio/judge/): An AI-produced courtroom comedy web series.
